description: This file contains utility functions for initializing and managing callbacks, extracting metadata, and handling guardrails within the litellm proxy system. It includes functions for processing callback configurations, managing request headers, and logging guardrail information.

methods.name: initialize_callbacks_on_proxy
methods.description: Initializes and processes callback configurations, importing necessary modules, creating callback instances, and extending the litellm.callbacks list.

methods.name: get_model_group_from_litellm_kwargs
methods.description: Extracts the model group name from litellm parameters in kwargs.

methods.name: get_model_group_from_request_data
methods.description: Retrieves the model group name from request data's metadata.

methods.name: get_remaining_tokens_and_requests_from_request_data
methods.description: Generates headers indicating remaining tokens and requests based on request metadata and model group.

methods.name: get_logging_caching_headers
methods.description: Returns headers related to guardrails, semantic similarity, and pillar response headers from request metadata.

methods.name: add_guardrail_to_applied_guardrails_header
methods.description: Adds a guardrail name to the list of applied guardrails in request metadata.

methods.name: add_guardrail_response_to_standard_logging_object
methods.description: Appends guardrail response information to the standard logging object.

methods.name: get_metadata_variable_name_from_kwargs
methods.description: Determines whether to use 'metadata' or 'litellm_metadata' as the metadata key based on kwargs.

methods.name: process_callback
methods.description: Processes a callback by retrieving environment variables and returning callback data.

methods.name: normalize_callback_names
methods.description: Normalizes callback names to lowercase if they are strings.
